```python
import subprocess
import shlex

ALLOWED = {"status", "version", "help"}

def run_tool(action: str) -> str:
    # 입력값 추가 검증 및 쉘 이스케이프 방지를 위해 shlex.quote() 사용
    if action not in ALLOWED:
        raise ValueError("action not allowed")
    safe_action = shlex.quote(action)
    result = subprocess.run(
        ["/usr/local/bin/mytool", safe_action],
        shell=False,
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        timeout=10,
    )
    return result.stdout
```
